description: This Java class defines BOMTree, an in-memory representation of a Bill of Materials (BOM) used for tree traversal, explosion, and implosion in manufacturing processes. It includes methods for constructing BOM trees, checking configuration, printing, summing quantities, and creating manufacturing orders.

classes.name: BOMTree
classes.description: Represents an in-memory BOM tree for traversal, explosion, and implosion, with methods for construction, configuration check, printing, and manufacturing order creation.

methods.name: BOMTree
methods.description: Constructor that builds BOMTree by reading downward from productId's BOM, with optional explosion or implosion.

methods.name: getInputProduct
methods.description: Returns the input product as a GenericValue.

methods.name: manufacturedAsProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the product associated with a 'PRODUCT_MANUFACTURED' association for a given productId and date.

methods.name: hasBom
methods.description: Checks if a product has a BOM for a given date.

methods.name: isConfigured
methods.description: Checks if the BOM tree is fully configured (no virtual nodes).

methods.name: getRootQuantity
methods.description: Returns the root quantity.

methods.name: setRootQuantity
methods.description: Sets the root quantity.

methods.name: getRootAmount
methods.description: Returns the root amount.

methods.name: setRootAmount
methods.description: Sets the root amount.

methods.name: getRoot
methods.description: Returns the root BOMNode.

methods.name: getInDate
methods.description: Returns the validity date of the BOM.

methods.name: getBomTypeId
methods.description: Returns the BOM type ID.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints BOM tree info into a StringBuffer for debugging.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints BOM tree info into a list with specified initial depth.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints BOM tree info into a list with specified initial depth and exclusion of WIP nodes.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints BOM tree info into a list without depth or exclusion parameters.

methods.name: sumQuantities
methods.description: Summarizes quantities of all nodes into a map keyed by productId.

methods.name: getAllProductsId
methods.description: Returns a list of all productIds in the BOM tree.

methods.name: createManufacturingOrders
methods.description: Creates manufacturing orders for nodes that need manufacturing, returning the work effort ID.

methods.name: getProductsInPackages
methods.description: Populates a list with products contained in packages within the BOM.
